data.gender_notes: Cyb is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Cybele was a goddess associated with fertility, mountains, and nature. Her name is derived from the Greek word for 'mountain' or 'mother'. In Christianity, Cyb could be a derivative of Cybele or a short form of Cyrus or Cyprian, both of which have biblical connections. The name Cyb carries the meaning “River of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cyb usually hope their child will grow to embody river of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine guidance and the power of nature.
data.etymology: Cyb belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “River of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cyb total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
